headline: An army of artists fooled the Nazis with inflatable tanks.
slides: The US Army formed the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops. 1,100 men.
Many were artists and designers, hand-picked from art schools in New York and Philadelphia.
Inflatable tanks and planes, giant speakers playing the sound of troops, fake radio traffic.
They staged more than 20 deceptions, pretending to be entire divisions.
It stayed classified until 1996. Fashion designer Bill Blass was one of them.
The unit was awarded the Congressional Gold Medal.
